title: fea.step
summary: Create a typed FEA analysis step.
description: `fea.step(id, kind)` creates a `fea.Step` from a text identifier and analysis kind.
behaviors: Exactly two text scalar inputs are required. Supported kinds are the analysis step kinds exposed by the selected model family.
Direct integer and resident numeric inputs have no role and reject before object construction.
The constructor is host-side and does not invoke a solver, provider, or native OCCT geometry path.

faqs.question: Where are step counts configured?
faqs.answer: Use the solver-specific `fea.runOptions` count fields; `fea.step` only identifies a typed analysis step.
